candidate_program.name: residual_moment_continuation
candidate_program.rationale: Compresses compatible weight by normalized weighted conflict load in the root-conditioned residual to approximate continuation value. It observes edges beyond one hop, although this aggregate need not resolve the witness; inducing the full residual can be quadratic.
candidate_program.rule: weight + compatible_weight / (1 + 2 * max(0, residual_pair_pressure)) - 0.05 * conflict_weight / (1 + max(0, degree))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
